## Hello, I'm Priyadharshini 👋

I'm an **MSc Business Analytics** student at **Dublin City University**, combining a background in Information Technology with data science and business intelligence skills.

My journey started with a BTech in IT from Rajalakshmi Engineering College in Chennai. Today I work at the intersection of data engineering and strategic analytics — using Python, SQL, machine learning, and visualisation to turn complex data into clear decisions.

I'm currently working on a real-world industry project with **Safefood (Seafood Ireland)** as part of the DCU MSc practicum.

📍 Dublin, Ireland
